Search request with max_results parameter limiting response count

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.search_async(LiterLlm::SearchRequest.new(max_results: 2, model: 'brave/web-search', query: 'Rust programming'))
puts result.results.inspect
```
